header: Identity and Access Management for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
content:
AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is an AWS service that helps an administrator securely
control access to AWS resources. IAM administrators control who can be authenticated (signed in)
and authorized (have permissions) to use OpenSearch Serverless resources. IAM is an AWS service
that you can use with no additional charge.
